items.prompt: What does ORDER BY QTY DESC with a QTY > 0 filter return?
items.why: The filter keeps rows with stock over zero and ORDER BY sorts them by quantity in descending order.

items.prompt: Using a calendar box instead of a text box provides which benefit?
items.why: A calendar only offers valid dates, so impossible dates cannot be entered.

items.prompt: Which 4-bit two's complement addition overflows?
items.why: -4 + -5 = -9, which is outside the 4-bit two's complement range of -8 to +7.

items.prompt: How many bits are needed to store an 8×8 black-and-white image?
items.why: An 8×8 image has 64 pixels, and each black-and-white pixel needs 1 bit.

items.prompt: Which stage involves validating questionnaires before input?
items.why: Validating questionnaires before input is part of data preparation.

items.prompt: Why is the BMP version of a photo larger than the JPG?
options: It cannot be shown in browsers
items.why: BMP stores pixels uncompressed, so the file is larger than the compressed JPG.

items.prompt: Which can be a mail merge data source?
items.why: Mail merge merges a main document with a data source such as a database file.

items.prompt: What is true about verbal annotation in slide presentations?
options: Each slide lasts the same time
items.why: Verbal annotation can be recorded individually for each slide, with each slide allowed its own duration.

items.prompt: In Goal Seek, which two cells do you set?
items.why: Goal Seek sets the target cell to a value by changing the input cell.

items.prompt: Why do computers use character sets such as ASCII?
items.why: Character sets standardise how text is represented so different systems agree on the same codes.

items.prompt: Why is information literacy important?
items.why: Information literacy lets people recognise fake information and assess credibility online.

items.prompt: What should be considered first when developing a management information system?
items.why: The purpose of the system drives every later decision, from design to implementation.

items.prompt: Which is a common specification of a home-use printer?
items.why: 1200 dpi is a resolution spec found in home-use printers; 802.11n is a wireless spec, not a data-rate spec.

items.prompt: A standalone computer is slow on database software. What should be upgraded?
items.why: More RAM lets the database software work faster; ROM and the network card are not the bottleneck.

items.prompt: Why use a thermal printer instead of a laser one for receipts?
items.why: Thermal printers are smaller and compact, which suits a cashier counter.

items.prompt: No Internet access. Which hardware failure could cause this?
items.why: The network interface card handles the connection; if it fails, the computer cannot reach the Internet.

items.prompt: Why should software be updated often?
items.why: Regular updates fix program bugs so the software runs correctly.

items.prompt: Why is autopilot driving a real-time processing system?
options: No delay between input and processing
items.why: Real-time processing responds immediately, with no delay between data input and processing.

items.prompt: How many 2TB disks store 100 uncompressed 300GB files, without reorganisation?
items.why: Each 2TB disk holds six 300GB files (1.8TB), so 100 files need 17 disks.

items.prompt: In https://www.abc.edu.hk/en/, what is 'en'?
options: A path on the web server
items.why: In a URL the part after the domain (/en/) is the path on the web server.

items.prompt: Which is a potential benefit of e-learning?
items.why: E-learning can track each learner's progress, and it also offers flexible schedules.

items.prompt: Which should be considered when designing web pages?
items.why: Web-page design considers loading time, browsing ease and colour combination.

items.prompt: Why is fibre optics used in a computer network?
options: Works best at very low distances
items.why: Fibre optics provides very high data transfer rates over long distances.

items.prompt: Why is Internet Protocol used in a computer network?
items.why: IP defines the same communication rules so computers can talk to each other.

items.prompt: What should Amy consider for streaming videos?
items.why: Streaming needs enough network bandwidth; local storage is not the issue.

items.prompt: What is the use of the value '888' in a summation loop?
items.why: The loop keeps going while the input is not 888, so 888 stops the input.

items.prompt: What does a good problem definition do?
items.why: A clear problem definition fixes the design and the scope of work.

items.prompt: Which is an advantage of modularity in programming?
items.why: Breaking a program into modules makes it easier to trace and team-work.

items.prompt: Why should appropriate test data be prepared?
items.why: Good test data reveals mistakes in the algorithm and checks exceptional inputs.

items.prompt: Files locked by ransomware. What should he do immediately?
items.why: Disconnecting the network stops the ransomware from spreading; format and antivirus are not first steps.

items.prompt: Which consideration is least important for the shopping-mall app?
items.why: Security, privacy and the operating system matter; the app's file size does not.

items.prompt: Which is a likely consequence of heavy Internet use?
items.why: Excessive use can harm physical fitness and attention, unlike copyright infringement, which is not a direct consequence.

items.prompt: Which is appropriate when using a social media app?
items.why: Read the terms of use and share only necessary personal information before posting.

items.prompt: Peter installs the software on two computers. What makes him copyright-safe?
options: The computers are in different countries
items.why: The licence permitting installation keeps Peter within copyright.

items.prompt: Which is correct about the use of robots?
items.why: Robots follow working procedures accurately and can take dirty, dangerous jobs.
